Joseph is a broad clean-shaven human admiral with slicked-back iron-grey hair, thick brows and a brass monocle over his RIGHT eye, high navy collar and extravagant gold epaulettes. NOT Rovan and NOT bald Grievous. He stands arrogantly at the command rail, one gloved hand waving off a worried human sailor in a worn navy work jacket and simple cap. Exactly TWO prominent people; a distant helmsman may be a small background crew figure. GOLD banner with NAVY balance scales. Through windows only jagged bare floating rocks and green magnetic arcs, no cities or ships needed. Sailor speaks first, Joseph replies with greedy confidence. Dialogue tails unambiguous. No red cloth, no silver knights.

STYLE: Magneton graphic novel: painted ink, tactile bronze machinery, silver Type C, crimson Veymarch cloth, navy/gold Auric Reach uniforms; atmospheric floating islands. Consistent with supplied scene references, not photorealistic.
